title: Initiative health dashboard & cycle sync for Developer Experience programs
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Goal: Create a single source-of-truth initiative health view and a repeatable cycle sync process for Developer Experience programs (SDKs, docs, quickstarts). This ticket tracks the program-level roadmap, the dashboard implementation, OKR mappings, and the communication cadence for quarterly planning and weekly reviews.

Scope:
- Health dashboard surface (metrics, trends, status tags) for initiatives spanning SDKs, docs, quickstarts.
- Integrations: product analytics (Amplitude), usage telemetry (internal ingestion), Console dashboards, and Linear issue status ingestion.
- OKR mapping: associate initiative progress to specific DX OKRs and targets.
- Cycle sync playbook: cadence, owners, slide template, and stakeholder notifications.

Out-of-scope for this ticket: deep instrumentation changes to SDKs (tracked in ENG-5042) and migration of docs search (tracked in ENG-5120).
comments: 2026-01-15: Kickoff meeting with Eng infra, Analytics, and DX reps. Agreed on three metric pillars: adoption, time-to-first-call (TTFC), and docs success rate.
2026-01-28: Design review — product asked for compact view + ability to filter by team and release. DES-211 assigned for visual mockups.
2026-02-10: Analytics team flagged that TTFC requires a small SDK event addition; ENG-5042 created. We scoped a shim to estimate TTFC until instrumentation ships.
2026-02-22: PM review — removed verbose event-level logs from MVP to respect privacy constraints; agreed to roll TTFC as an estimated metric with a label 'estimated' until SDK events land.
2026-02-28: First implementation spike completed. Backend ingestion and minimal API for dashboard prototypes available at /internal/devx-health. PR: github.com/redwood/reports/pull/814.
2026-03-05: Stakeholder sync — Legal reviewed data plan and requested retention adjustments; change logged in ENG-5199 (compliance).
2026-03-10: Roadmap decision: ship dashboard MVP in console-2026.04 with weekly automated emails to initiative owners; iterate on drilldowns in next cycle.
acceptance_criteria: MVP dashboard shows adoption, TTFC (estimated if not instrumented), and docs success rate for all active DX initiatives.
Dashboard allows filtering by initiative, team, and release tag.
Automated weekly email summary is sent to initiative owners and PM leads.
Each initiative card links back to its Linear parent issue and to the related Console route.
OKR mapping table is editable by PMs and stored in Confluence (link included).
metrics: Adoption: new SDK installs / active keys (weekly)
TTFC: median time from signup to first successful API call (hours) — estimated until ENG-5042 completes
Docs success rate: percent of sessions with successful code sample run or 'Got it' click (tracked via docs telemetry)
Onboarding drop-off rate: percent of users who start but do not complete quickstart within 24 hours

Ship front-end MVP to /console/insights/devx-health and run internal dogfood week starting 2026-04-01.
